import json,time,urllib.request
OLLAMA="http://127.0.0.1:11434"
MODEL="qwen2.5-coder:1.5b-instruct-q4_K_M"
def get(path):
    with urllib.request.urlopen(OLLAMA+path,timeout=5) as r:return json.load(r)
def post(payload):
    req=urllib.request.Request(OLLAMA+"/api/chat",data=json.dumps(payload).encode(),headers={"Content-Type":"application/json"},method="POST")
    t=time.perf_counter()
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=29) as r:b=json.load(r)
    return round((time.perf_counter()-t)*1000,3),b
print("PHASE=qwen_reload_after_aux")
print("PS_BEFORE="+json.dumps(get("/api/ps"),separators=(",",":")))
wall,b=post({"model":MODEL,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Reply OK."}],"stream":False,"options":{"num_ctx":4096,"num_predict":1,"temperature":0}})
out={"model":MODEL,"wall_ms":wall}
for k in ("total_duration","load_duration","prompt_eval_duration","eval_duration","prompt_eval_count","eval_count"):
    if k in b: out[k+"_ms" if k.endswith("_duration") else k]=round(b[k]/1e6,3) if k.endswith("_duration") else b[k]
print("QWEN_RELOAD="+json.dumps(out,separators=(",",":")))
print("PS_AFTER="+json.dumps(get("/api/ps"),separators=(",",":")))
PY
